name: autoencoder
title: Autoencoder
summary: A neural network trained to reconstruct benign behaviour; poorly reconstructed employee-days are anomalous.

name: cnn
title: 1-D convolutional network
summary: A convolution slid across the feature vector, then pooled into a classification head.

name: decision_tree
title: Decision tree
summary: A single tree of threshold rules, grown until its leaves are pure.

name: gnn
title: Graph convolutional network
summary: A two-layer graph convolution over a behavioural-similarity graph of employee-days.

name: isolation_forest
title: Isolation forest
summary: An unsupervised anomaly detector: it scores how easily an observation is isolated by random splits.

name: logistic_regression
title: Logistic regression
summary: A linear model that estimates the probability an employee-day is malicious from a weighted sum of the features.

name: lstm
title: LSTM
summary: A long short-term memory network followed by a linear classification head.

name: random_forest
title: Random forest
summary: 300 decision trees trained on resampled data and features, averaged.

name: svm
title: Support vector machine
summary: A kernel classifier that finds the maximum-margin boundary between classes.

name: autoencoder_rnn_hybrid
title: Autoencoder-RNN hybrid
summary: An autoencoder's latent representation fed into an LSTM classification head.

name: cnn_rnn_hybrid
title: CNN-RNN hybrid
summary: A convolutional feature extractor feeding an LSTM, then a classification head.

name: gradient_boosting
title: Gradient boosting
summary: Trees added one at a time, each correcting the errors of those before it.

name: stacking_ensemble
title: Stacking ensemble
summary: Trains a second-level model on the out-of-fold predictions of three base models.

name: trust_weighted_ensemble
title: Trust-weighted ensemble
summary: Averages three detectors, then damps the score for employees with high trust.

name: voting_ensemble
title: Soft-voting ensemble
summary: Averages the predicted probabilities of three different models.
